title: About Our Company | Winkelmann Group
content: # The Winkelmann Group. The Winkelmann Group is a world-leading metal processing company with Automotive, Building+Industry and Flowforming divisions and a demand-focused supplier to steel processing companies. Our group of companies have been headquartered in the Westphalian town of Ahlen in Germany’s Münsterland since the parent company was founded in 1898. Today, our company also has a presence in Poland, Turkey, China and the USA and is an internationally recognized expert in metal forming. Our production is typified by innovative and resource-efficient approaches, integrated development, and an equal exchange of views with our suppliers and business partners. With more than a hundred years of success, our family business, the Winkelmann Group has developed into a leading group of companies worldwide, focusing on our core competence of metal forming. Through our Automotive, reflexGroup, Flowforming and Construction Components business units, we manufacture high-performance systems and components by means of high-tech production processes involving forming, machining and assembly. The Winkelmann Group is one of the leading companies in the field of metal forming. Automotive More than 100 years of know-how in metal forming technology with finesse in joining and painting, innovative potential in plastics technology and unconventional solutions in torsional vibration technology make up the business unit Automotive of the Winkelmann Group. Building + Industry Our products in the fields of heating, energy and plant engineering are state of the art thanks to our own research, development, cooperation with research institutes and production methods. Steel Services The Steel Services business unit has made a name for itself worldwide as an experienced and competent service provider in steel procurement and guarantees the disposition and just-in-time supply of flat steel products to the processing industry. Winkelmann Group is located in Ahlen, North Rhine-Westphalia, DE.
